children: The Boring Company (TBC), founded by Elon Musk, has secured $3 billion in its Series D funding round, led by the United Arab Emirates and affiliated investment entities, valuing the tunnelling and infrastructure startup at $23 billion.

The company said the investment will support the expansion of its partnership with the UAE and accelerate the deployment of large-scale underground infrastructure projects across the country, including more than 150 kilometres of tunnels.

The funding builds on the company's existing collaboration with the UAE through the Dubai Loop project, a 24-kilometer underground high-speed transport network. However, the latest agreement is separate from the Dubai Loop contract that was previously awarded, TBC said.

Other investors participating in the funding round include Human Capital, Vy Capital, Valor Equity Partners, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Temasek, Shamal Holding and Baron Capital, alongside other existing and new investors.

The funds from the round will be used to significantly increase hiring across engineering, operations, and production, to build and scale Loop projects, including Vegas Loop, Music City Loop in Nashville, and in Dubai.
TBC did not disclose the timing of the fund deployment or provide further details on the UAE infrastructure projects.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Musk’s Boring Company raises $3bln in UAE-led round, valuing startup at $23bln
